name: iumrah-beta-update-20260910-hotel-origin-geolocation-configurator-v1
changes: Shared departure-airport field in Trip Builder and Hotels tab
Automatic nearest-airport detection using iOS When-In-Use location permission
Hotel storefront flight baseline follows selected/detected origin instead of hardcoded TAS
Regional return fallback to TAS when no compatible return to the departure city exists
Hotel package duration follows the compatible published outbound/return pair when available
Hotel package tier mapping: <=3 stars Standard, 4 stars Comfort, >=5 stars Luxury
Hotel cards and Hotel Detail use the same single automatic package quote
All user-facing iumrah Package System wording changed to iumrah Configurator
